class.name: JustAMCPPromptProjectInfo
class.brief_description: Provides a built-in prompt with project.blazium metadata.
class.description: A [JustAMCPPrompt] implementation that reads project metadata such as the project name, configured main scene, version fields, and related settings from [code]project.blazium[/code] (or [code]project.godot[/code] as a fallback).
